title: Paired global Horn reachability under matched radius-two public local structure and prospective STOP calibration

frozen.per_seed_checkpoint: Use original AF23 immutable SHA-pinned checkpoint with original train receipt and Torch/NumPy parity. Each seed's logistic gate trained from scratch exclusively on its train pair cohort.
frozen.model_inputs: Same 15 physical atoms/14 rule slots, known state and original role markers 6,13,14. All model-visible GraphBatch.targets set to zero for every case to prevent latent truth-label leakage.
frozen.no_truth_inference: Neither exact BFS distance nor matched-pair true label nor pair identity nor data split passes to recurrent score features or STOP decision.

matched_pair_construction.pair_operation: At a middle Horn-rule premise, swap the input atoms 5 (reachable) and 10 (unreachable) between exactly two same-arity single-premise rules. In positive, productive rule consumes 5 and decoy rule consumes 10. In negative, productive rule consumes 10 and decoy consumes 5. Keep all other physical rule heads/premises, initial facts, atom and rule permutation, marked roles, complete degree sequence and goal-concluding rules identical within pair.
matched_pair_construction.structural_distance: Require identical *identity-preserving directed bipartite radius-2 incidence neighborhoods* around each original root-known fact and each of three marked subgoal/goal atoms (6,13,14). Anchor signatures include present/initial, marked role, every atom/rule physical ID and directed premise/head edge whose endpoints both fall within BFS distance <=2 of that anchor.
matched_pair_construction.pair_difference: Only two premise edges are exchanged (four sparse tensor entries changed); rule heads, atom features, role markers, initial known bits, rule features and complete degrees fixed.
matched_pair_construction.exact_goal_truth: Positive pair member has independently certified shortest proof at registered depth; negative pair member cannot derive goal under full positive-Horn least fixed point (independent bitset BFS). Both have at least two distinct enabled root rules.
matched_pair_construction.source_separation: Distinct unpermuted Horn-rule template signatures among TRAIN, DEV and held-out families. Positive/negative members retain identical physical atom and rule slot permutations, chosen solely from split/family/pair index.
matched_pair_construction.structural_null: A classifier restricted to the registered radius-2 anchored signature must assign equal score to both members of every pair; any deterministic binary classification has exactly 50% accuracy on the balanced 192-case roster if pair tie handling is symmetric.
matched_pair_construction.hard_gate: Independent physical and bitset BFS, full closure, pair-swap check, radius-2 signature equality, degree equality, zero model input targets and disjoint split/historical public hashes must pass BEFORE loading any checkpoint or fitting a STOP model.

training.logistic: Reuse original AF28 balanced-BCE six-feature train-only logistic calibrator and matched one-feature Direct-margin logistic control. Source frozen checkpoint unchanged.
training.train_rows: Root + two deterministic legal first-rule successor states per source train case, deduplicated; labels only from train independent BFS, never heldout.
training.train_loss: AF28 full-batch 600 updates at 0.1, L2=0.01, class-balanced binary cross entropy, clipped standardized train features; zero original recurrent optimizer updates
training.dev_root_selection: Exactly 192 dev root samples (96 reachable,96 unreachable), search threshold grid 0.05..0.95. Choose threshold that maximizes correct DEV negative STOP while continuing on >=87/96 DEV positives; ties choose largest threshold. If no grid threshold meets criterion, use 0.95.
training.no_hindsight: Train/dev pair labels permitted solely for supervised fit and threshold grid. No source-heldout logits or labels examined before calibrator artifacts are immutable.

inference.neural_policy: Original Direct rule ranking is fixed in all neural arms; STOP source switches from original Direct to original VI2 to logistic CAL/THR to always continue. All decisions use fresh on-policy frozen-network forwards on reached host states.
inference.action_budget: Exact independent shortest proof length +1 legal rule firing on provable; two decisions on unprovable
inference.controls: Source original AF24 public closure, BFS16/64, and exact shortest oracle as evaluation-only upper bound. All use exact same public physical graph and host action legality.
inference.pair_diagnostic: From the initial root record both CAL and THR STOP probabilities and native Direct/VI2 STOP-margin scores. For matched pair, compute signed difference STOP_prob(unreachable)-STOP_prob(reachable); ties counted half. Never tune on this heldout value.

preregistered_primary.first_gate: CAL ranks unreachable member higher than its matched reachable member in >=65 out of 96 pairs per held depth, counting a tie as half a correct pair.
preregistered_primary.paired_control: Record THR, Direct and VI2 margin paired AUC identically, with native scores compared ONLY within same scorer across the two pair members.
preregistered_primary.second_gate: CAL correct immediate STOP on at least 60/96 unreachable roots AND completes at least DD_positive_completions-5 out of 96 reachable roots at each held depth, with zero accepted false Horn proofs.
preregistered_primary.seed_gate: Both first_gate and second_gate must pass on BOTH held depths in same frozen original checkpoint seed.
preregistered_primary.interpretability: This tests discriminability of matched local neighborhoods using full public graph and recurrent features. Public closure trivially obtains exact reachability and remains a nonlearned strong control, so even PASS would not establish useful neural proof-search superiority.

reporting.per_seed: All 8 fixed seeds, 96 exact positive-negative pairs per depth, binary pair wins/ties, original-root AUC, negative STOP, complete positive proofs, later premature STOP and true proof soundness.
reporting.probability: Initial-root Brier, NLL and ECE for CAL/THR, per-pair score-gap histogram, uniform threshold baselines; root local radius2-only has 50% paired accuracy by certificate.
reporting.error: Paired discordance of original Direct vs new fitted CAL, root false STOP/false continue, category by family and seed
reporting.compute: Original recurrent node-forward count, independently replayed logits, symbolic rule examinations and host-state expansions, no equal-FLOP claim.
reporting.audit: Save source manifest, exact per-pair graph hashes and two swapped rules, train/dev feature and threshold receipts and every full heldout episode. SHA-pin artifacts and original model provenance. All earlier AF22–AF28 outcomes unchanged.
